hypothesis: Can a tokenless causal learner infer exception-state membership and a new action-composition operator from genuine interventions, not choose CKAD48's four named partitions, and beat an unrestricted fully trained conditional control in genuinely changed nonlinear mechanics?

worlds.mapping: Two distinct bijections of actions 0-3 onto four operator deltas, one per hidden state class; class1 map is rotated from class0 and is hidden from all learners.
worlds.noise: Transition .9 intended next state, .1/3 each alternative; terminal reward .9 for true-bit else .1.
worlds.public_source: s0,a1,s1,a2,s2,y; two actually witnessed transitions and final reward. All arms train identical rows exactly once; no oracle hidden mapping or sampled counterfactual.

candidate.mechanism: Build finite state-group feature hypotheses from observed conditional delta distributions instead of using CKAD48's four named partitions. Search canonical all 7 two-group partitions plus a pooled baseline, with both XOR and modular-add operators (16 structural hypotheses). Dirichlet(.25) action-by-group effect counts and Beta(1,1) state-reward counts. Every actual witnessed transition updates prequential Bayesian structural evidence and learned counts. Use full posterior averaging until best hypothesis posterior >=0.80, then hard-select the learned relation for both composed interventions. Preserve all structural hypotheses, old evidence and raw source IDs without reset.
candidate.limit: The correct structure IS in this newly extended finite search family, although it was absent from CKAD48's restricted state partitions/XOR-only bank. This is not arbitrary new feature invention or unrestricted physical law discovery.

strong_controls.exact_full: Independent fully source-trained Bayesian model averaging over all 16 structure hypotheses with same prior and reward Beta; two-step prediction shares the same hypothesis, not separate latent assignments. No private true structure.
strong_controls.tabular: Independently trained 16 state/action 4-way transition Dirichlet(.25) plus reward-state Beta; unrestricted physical action-state conditionals.
strong_controls.ckad48_restricted: Independent source-trained original four named partitions invariant/lowbit/highbit/parity with XOR only and exact BMA.
strong_controls.sham: Uniform terminal reward 0.5; not a strong baseline.

data_and_science.query: For each time before its actual source event, read-only exhaustive 4 initial states x4 first actions x4 second actions=64 queries. Scoring uses evaluator-private exact expected Bernoulli Brier, which NEVER trains candidate or controls. Scored phases early novel 80/96, late novel 144/160/176, cold return 192/208/224/240, pooled final 7.

frozen_go.decision: Any failed threshold: DEV_NO_GO or SOURCE_INVALID. Passing all development thresholds: DEV_FEASIBLE_NOT_SCIENTIFIC, never SCIENTIFIC_PASS. No tuning or replay on consumed original seeds; no automatic held first-use.

fixture_controls: New state singleton exceptions and mod4 action operators are distinguishable from the old restricted CKAD48 invariance. A separate arbitrary lookup state-action map outside the new finite structure must favor fully fitted tabular; verify duplicate/conflict atomicity and cold restore and read purity using only engineering fixture seed zero.
cost_and_authority: Measured whole-process CPU/wall and checkpoint bytes, source actions/outcomes matched but compute not matched. Research-only folder/workflow and stacked draft PR. No accepted binary Yggdrasil API changes, owner training, first-use, merge, controller, scheduler, paid API or deployment. No full final regression unless candidate scientific qualification and owner accepted.
